verdict.rationale: Claude Code offers CLAUDE.md as a shared, versionable context file read at every session and can pull in docs from Google Drive, Jira, and Slack, which could serve as building blocks for a shared source of truth. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated 'workspace' construct for aggregating docs and repos as a persistent team knowledge base—these are ad hoc integrations rather than a purpose-built shared workspace feature.
